bull.b: The masked tri-specific design addresses major limitations of existing T-cell engagers in solid tumors. Dual immune-cell engagement and tumor-selective activation could support durable competitive differentiation if clinical testing confirms the preclinical safety and efficacy profile.

bull.t: Promising preclinical efficacy and safety data
bull.b: Consistent efficacy across patient-derived resistant tumor models, combined with improved pharmacokinetics and limited cytokine release, strengthens the scientific rationale for clinical development. These findings may improve partnering prospects and reduce safety-related development risk.

bear.t: No established revenue base and widening losses
bear.b: The absence of recurring commercial revenue leaves valuation support and operating funding dependent on future milestones, partnerships, or financing. Continued losses show that the pipeline has not yet created a stable economic engine and could increase dilution risk.

bear.t: Persistent cash burn and limited funding runway
bear.b: Negative cash generation means the company remains dependent on external capital before clinical assets can produce revenue. The stated runway is defined but limited, creating recurring financing risk as Phase 1 development and other pipeline work require additional resources.
